title: Table hands a truncation tooltip the cell's rendered node, which Tooltip's own entry forbids
foundBy: consumer report on three applications pinned to 0.2.1-dev, verified against 0c015ef
details:
`src/components/Table.tsx` passes `content={col.cell(row, activeFilterQuery)}` to the `Tooltip` around a non-wrapping cell, and renders the same call again inside the trigger. A rich cell is therefore rendered twice, once in the table and once in a portal.

`catalog.json` lists this under Tooltip's own `avoid_when`: "The content is interactive (links, buttons) — a tooltip is not a popover". A cell returning a link, a button or any element with an `id` produces a duplicated id and a control in a portal, which is an accessibility defect rather than a cosmetic one. A cell returning a `StatusBadge` duplicates a `data-component` root.

The predecessor did not have this shape. It set `title` from `textContent`, which is text by construction.

The component and its own catalogue entry disagree, and the entry is right.
